findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed soda nozzle on Coca-Cola machine next to the UPS store to have a build up of soils. Discussed with PIC. PIC cleaned the nozzles and internal surface of the Coca Cola soda dispenser machine as a corrective action.. Ensure soda machine nozzle is cleaned regularly to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.

Inspector will return on 10/21/25 for a followup

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Inspector observed the external surface on the slushie dispenser to be soiled. Discussed with PIC. PIC ensured inspector that the machine external surface will be cleaned as the distributor is the only party that is allowed to clean certain areas within the machine. Ensure that the surface identified is clear to sight of touch.

Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11(A) Inspector observed a few dairy food items being store on the floor in the dairy walk-in cooler. PIC was made aware and PIC immediately remove the items and stored them appropriately. Ensure that food items stored at least 6 inches from the floor to protect them from splash, dust, and other contaminants. 

Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Inspector observed a mop head being stored on the floor in the produce aisle. PIC was made aware and the mop head was removed to be store properly. Ensure that mop heads are stored in a position that allows them to air dry. 

Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.13(B) Inspector observed the caulking on the hand sink in the produce sorting and storage area to be unsealed to the wall. Discussed with PIC. PIC ensured inspector that the relevant repairs will be done to keep the hand sink sealed to the wall. Ensure that this hand sink is caulked to the wall to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface. 

 Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (B) The floors in FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain, and the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.
